title.zh: LangSmith Tool Gateway 进入公测：按需发现工具，授权留在网关
title.en: LangSmith Tool Gateway enters public beta: discover tools on demand, keep auth at the gateway

summary.zh: LangSmith 公测 Tool Gateway，把工具打包为一个 MCP 地址，Search Mode 按需发现；授权身份、工具级权限与调用记录则留在网关。Harrison Chase 的发布帖特别强调用谁的身份调用。这与同日 Gemini API 的 Tool Retrieval 都是按需加载，但控制点不同，不合并为一条。
summary.en: LangSmith opened a public beta of Tool Gateway. Tools are bundled at one MCP address, Search Mode discovers them on demand, and caller identity, tool-level permissions, and invocation logs stay at the gateway. Harrison Chase's announcement stressed whose identity is used for calls. Gemini API Tool Retrieval the same day is also on-demand loading, but the control point is different, so the two are not one event.

brief.zh: LangSmith Tool Gateway 进入公测：工具集中在一个 MCP 地址，可按需发现，授权、权限和调用记录留在网关。
brief.en: LangSmith Tool Gateway enters public beta: tools sit behind one MCP address, can be discovered on demand, and auth, permissions, and logs stay at the gateway.

why.zh: 发现和授权应该分开看。模型知道工具存在，不代表它已经获准调用。
why.en: Discovery and authorization should be read separately. Knowing a tool exists is not the same as being allowed to call it.
